description: Find Texas AG opinions interpreting a given statute (e.g. "552.101" (Public Information Act), "551" (Open Meetings Act)) or citing it as a keyword. For Chapter 552/551 citations this returns real opinions (number, date, one-line summary) live from the AG's own topic-category index; other chapters fall back to opinions the AG's RECORDED overruled/modified/affirmed/withdrawn index cites this statute in. PARTIAL CAPABILITY: this is not a full-text search of the whole ~19,000-opinion archive, which needs an authentication this pack does not have -- see the response's coverage_note for exactly what was searched. For a specific opinion's full text, use tx_ag_opinion_lookup.

citation.description: A statute citation or keyword to search for, e.g. "552.101" or "Tex. Gov't Code 2054.5191" or "Open Meetings".

name: tx_ag_statute_search
title: Tx Ag Statute Search
